Menu-open callback conditionally calls SetupPositionOverrideForWZEndGame only on first event; callback is registered on the parent menu. It saves __on_close_removeOverrides to remove that callback, then registers self.__onClose via CallOriginalSecond; because __onClose is outside frozen span, do not claim removal actually executes on close.
